facts.value: Caches the captive, linked carrier and carrier second hit capsule before capture cleanup clears the links. It derives the captive XRotN world position, computes applied knockback with hit->unk_count as the stored capsule argument, and copies angle, opposite carrier facing, hurtbox index1, collision position and element into captive damage fields. Attribution handling, conditional damage accumulation, knockback processing and damage dispatch consume these values.
facts.rationale: Correct exact branch order, operand scope or compiler-pool interpretation; avoid asserting coefficient sign, automatic timeout or animation acceleration without supporting values. Existing objects are corroboration only.

facts.value: First processes grab mash using an amount selected from the carrier ground state and stores the result in shouldered.x4. It then checks grab_timer<=0; that branch processes carrier damage before captive release damage and returns. Otherwise every nonzero x0, including negative values, decrements. If this branch leaves x0<=0 without mash, it requests rate1 and sets x0=0. If x0<=0 with mash and exact ShoulderedWait, it reloads x3B0 and requests shouldered_anim_rate. SetAnimRate may defer the request under x2223_b0. There is no unconditional grab_timer decrement in this callback or GrabMash.
facts.rationale: Correct exact branch order, operand scope or compiler-pool interpretation; avoid asserting coefficient sign, automatic timeout or animation acceleration without supporting values. Existing objects are corroboration only.

facts.value: GrabMash runs before the grab-timer test. A nonpositive processed timer dispatches carrier damage first, then cuts capture and dispatches captive damage. Otherwise a nonzero struggle countdown decrements; eligible mash requests the configured animation rate and reloads the countdown. The rate magnitude is not established here and the animation setter may defer its application.
